ops.text: 12.6.6 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, Harpoon shall (a) provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Harpoon's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination, return to AbbVie all data and Information of AbbVie in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data and Information from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to AbbVie.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added a single wind-down provision requiring Harpoon, on expiry or termination, to provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our data within thirty (30) days in a standard machine-readable format, and then delete and certify deletion. Our playbook requires an orderly transition and data return before any deletion; 90 days of assistance with a 30-day export would be an acceptable fallback.
input.summary: Insert Section 12.6.6 requiring Harpoon transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, and certified deletion.
